goal.purpose: Provide one development workflow entrypoint with project-specific profile mappings.
goal.done: Existing consumers route to the verified workflow and superseded workflow assets are recoverably archived.
goal.scope: Project intake through design, implementation, testing, delivery and safe workflow migration.
goal.exclude: Product behavior changes, production database writes, external delivery and automatic approval.

knowledge.invariant: Accepted requirements, actual test evidence, project state and human decisions retain their established owners.
Each development project maintains at least one map; independent features may be split without replacing existing maps.
The project-local Skill snapshot resolves its local references without a neighboring checkout; upstream-only examples have versioned links.
Workspace-specific gates, stores and procedures are resolved from the applicable profile without reentering a retired workflow.
Independent review applies when material risk, the active profile, contract or repository requires it.
Configured document and database-change standards remain active through the FMW workflow.
Test selection follows changed guarantees; starting state is adjusted only when required for reliable judgment.
knowledge.constraint: Preserve and verify old workflow assets and migrate their active consumers before removing their original folders.

item.next: Validate each affected consumer and its store before switching or retiring an old entrypoint.

open.item: Existing consumer routing and archive readiness must be established for the final candidate.
